source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.

injury: surgical ablation of about 85% of the left eye tissue (lens placode and most of optic cup) at stage 27

intervention.description: Embryos (injected at 4-cell stage with GFP and dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA, no inducer) bathed in 20 nM concanamycin A after eye ablation

readout.method: eye regrowth category (full, partial, weak, none) by size and morphology

notes: 22.6% fully regrown (RI=131, n=110); 24.9 -> 25. Family mapping: paper scores regrowth as full/partial/weak/none; full regrowth mapped to normal and all non-full categories pooled into eye_defect (paper reports only % full here). Count = percent x n. Embryos carry uninduced NICD construct (no dexamethasone); treated as the concanamycin-alone arm.

source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.

injury: surgical ablation of about 85% of the left eye tissue (lens placode and most of optic cup) at stage 27

intervention.description: Embryos injected at 4-cell stage with GFP and dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA, bathed in 20 nM concanamycin A and 10 uM dexamethasone after eye ablation

readout.method: eye regrowth category (full, partial, weak, none) by size and morphology

notes: 75.5% fully regrown (RI=260, n=106); 80.0 -> 80. Family mapping: paper scores regrowth as full/partial/weak/none; full regrowth mapped to normal and all non-full categories pooled into eye_defect (paper reports only % full here). Count = percent x n. Dose shown is concanamycin only.
